scope: Eleven completed Valorant development clips only. Do not open test media, labels, caches, or metrics during model development. Xonotic remains reserved.
validation: Nested leave-one-clip-out: each outer validation clip is excluded in both original and cleaned forms. Threshold selection uses inner leave-one-clip-out on the other ten clips only. Pooled outer predictions are the reported development score.
head: Four independent L2-regularized logistic regressions on fixed pretrained embeddings. C=0.1, balanced class weights, max_iter=400. Standardization fitted on training fold only. Unsupported labels are held at probability zero.
training_target: Multi-label sound present in the causal audio window, requiring at least 20 ms overlap. Include centered sound examples; suppress centered output at caption time. Talking/music define evaluation context only, not sound targets.
caption_policy: Frozen round-0 scheduler, timing and scorer. Direction estimated from original stereo, never the voice-reduced sibling.
threshold_selection: One global threshold selected on inner validation. Prefer <=2 literal false captions/min, then highest event recall, then fewer unmatched/min. If none feasible, minimize false/min before recall. Report unmatched/min alongside literal false/min.

rounds.purpose: Original-only control to measure whether voice-reduced training augmentation helps
Same head and encoder, training on original plus aligned voice-reduced copies
Stronger mn10_as encoder plus mono/side features, retaining original plus cleaned training pairs

stop: After these three training rounds, if the best pooled outer real-clip recall is below 50%, stop and report without opening sealed tests. If eligible for final comparison, freeze the selected model/settings before opening sealed test data once; stop if final real Valorant score is below 50%.
context_policy: User says all clips are labeled/finished. Use manually supplied talking/music intervals; complement is quiet for these reviewed development clips only. Overlapping context slices can overlap. Context membership is based on event/caption onset and false/min exposure on interval union length.
final_comparison: Test answer keys were revised after round 0. At the final comparison only, rescore immutable round-0 cached predictions against the same current answer keys used for after scores; preserve the historical round-0 report.
